arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا

translations.en.sahih: By those [angels] lined up in rows
translations.en.pickthall: By those who set the ranks in battle order
translations.en.yusufali: By those who range themselves in ranks,
translations.id.indonesian: Demi (rombongan) yang ber shaf-shaf dengan sebenar-benarnya],

translations.en.sahih: And those who drive [the clouds]
translations.en.pickthall: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
translations.en.yusufali: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
translations.id.indonesian: dan demi (rombongan) yang melarang dengan sebenar-benarnya (dari perbuatan-perbuatan maksiat),

translations.en.sahih: And those who recite the message,
translations.en.pickthall: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
translations.en.yusufali: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!
translations.id.indonesian: dan demi (rombongan) yang membacakan pelajaran,

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your God is One,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Esa.

arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
transliteration: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa Rabbul mashaariq

translations.en.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
translations.en.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.
translations.en.yusufali: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
translations.id.indonesian: Tuhan langit dan bumi dan apa yang berada di antara keduanya dan Tuhan tempat-tempat terbit matahari.

arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
transliteration: Innaa zaiyannas samaaa 'ad dunyaa bizeenatinil kawaakib

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
translations.en.yusufali: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menghias langit yang terdekat dengan hiasan, yaitu bintang-bintang,

transliteration: Wa hifzam min kulli Shaitaanim maarid

translations.en.sahih: And as protection against every rebellious devil
translations.en.pickthall: With security from every froward devil.
translations.en.yusufali: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
translations.id.indonesian: dan telah memeliharanya (sebenar-benarnya) dari setiap syaitan yang sangat durhaka,

arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ
transliteration: Laa yassamma 'oona ilal mala il a'alaa wa yuqzafoona min kulli jaanib

translations.en.sahih: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
translations.en.pickthall: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
translations.en.yusufali: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
translations.id.indonesian: syaitan syaitan itu tidak dapat mendengar-dengarkan (pembicaraan) para malaikat dan mereka dilempari dari segala penjuru.

translations.en.sahih: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
translations.en.pickthall: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
translations.en.yusufali: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
translations.id.indonesian: Untuk mengusir mereka dan bagi mereka siksaan yang kekal,

arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ
transliteration: Illaa man khatifal khatfata fa atba'ahoo shihaabun saaqib

translations.en.sahih: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
translations.en.pickthall: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
translations.en.yusufali: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
translations.id.indonesian: akan tetapi barangsiapa (di antara mereka) yang mencuri-curi (pembicaraan); maka ia dikejar oleh suluh api yang cemerlang.

arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
transliteration: Fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnaa; innaa khalaqnaahum min teenil laazib

translations.en.sahih: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
translations.en.pickthall: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
translations.en.yusufali: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tanyakanlah kepada mereka (musyrik Mekah): "Apakah mereka yang lebih kukuh kejadiannya ataukah apa yang telah Kami ciptakan itu?" Sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan mereka dari tanah liat.

translations.en.sahih: But you wonder, while they mock,
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
translations.en.yusufali: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan kamu menjadi heran (terhadap keingkaran mereka) dan mereka menghinakan kamu.

translations.en.sahih: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
translations.en.pickthall: And heed not when they are reminded,
translations.en.yusufali: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila mereka diberi pelajaran mereka tiada mengingatnya.

transliteration: Wa izaa ra aw Aayatinw yastaskhiroon

translations.en.sahih: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
translations.en.pickthall: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
translations.en.yusufali: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apabila mereka melihat sesuatu tanda kebesaran Allah, mereka sangat menghinakan.

arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
transliteration: Wa qaalooo in haazaa illaa sihrum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
translations.en.pickthall: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
translations.en.yusufali: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata "Ini tiada lain hanyalah sihir yang nyata.

arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
transliteration: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamab'oosoon

translations.en.sahih: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
translations.en.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
translations.en.yusufali: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah apabila kami telah mati dan telah menjadi tanah serta menjadi tulang belulang, apakah benar-benar kami akan dibangkitkan (kembali)?

translations.en.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
translations.en.pickthall: And our forefathers?
translations.en.yusufali: "And also our fathers of old?"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan apakah bapak-bapak kami yang telah terdahulu (akan dibangkitkan pula)"?

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
translations.en.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
translations.en.yusufali: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Ya, dan kamu akan terhina"

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
transliteration: Fa innamaa hiya zajra tunw waahidatun fa izaa hum yanzuroon

translations.en.sahih: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
translations.en.pickthall: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
translations.en.yusufali: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sesungguhnya kebangkitan itu hanya dengan satu teriakan saja; maka tiba-tiba mereka meIihatnya.

transliteration: Qa qaaloo yaa wailanaa haazaa Yawmud-Deen

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
translations.en.pickthall: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
translations.en.yusufali: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Aduhai celakalah kita!" Inilah hari pembalasan.

arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
transliteration: Haazaa Yawmul Faslil lazee kuntum bihee tukaziboon

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
translations.en.pickthall: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
translations.en.yusufali: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
translations.id.indonesian: Inilah hari keputusan yang kamu selalu mendustakannya.

arabic: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
transliteration: Uhshurul lazeena zalamoo wa azwaajahum wa maa kaanoo ya'budoon

translations.en.sahih: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
translations.en.pickthall: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
translations.en.yusufali: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
translations.id.indonesian: (kepada malaikat diperintahkan): "Kumpulkanlah orang-orang yang zalim beserta teman sejawat mereka dan sembahan-sembahan yang selalu mereka sembah,

arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Min doonil laahi fahdoohum ilaa siraatil Jaheem

translations.en.sahih: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
translations.en.pickthall: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
translations.en.yusufali: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
translations.id.indonesian: selain Allah; maka tunjukkanlah kepada mereka jalan ke neraka.

translations.en.sahih: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
translations.en.pickthall: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
translations.en.yusufali: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan tahanlah mereka (di tempat perhentian) karena sesungguhnya mereka akan ditanya:

translations.en.sahih: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
translations.en.pickthall: What aileth you that ye help not one another?
translations.en.yusufali: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"
translations.id.indonesian: "Kenapa kamu tidak tolong menolong?"

translations.en.sahih: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan mereka pada hari itu menyerah diri.

translations.en.sahih: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
translations.en.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
translations.en.yusufali: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
translations.id.indonesian: Sebahagian dan mereka menghadap kepada sebahagian yang lain berbantah-bantahan.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
translations.en.pickthall: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
translations.en.yusufali: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
translations.id.indonesian: Pengikut-pengikut mereka berkata (kepada pemimpin-pemimpin mereka): "Sesungguhnya kamulah yang datang kepada kami dan kanan.

translations.en.sahih: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
translations.en.pickthall: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
translations.en.yusufali: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
translations.id.indonesian: Pemimpin-pemimpin mereka menjawab: "Sebenarnya kamulah yang tidak beriman".

arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ
transliteration: Wa maa kaana lanaa 'alaikum min sultaanim bal kuntum qawman taagheen

translations.en.sahih: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
translations.en.pickthall: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
translations.en.yusufali: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sekali-kali kami tidak berkuasa terhadapmu, bahkan kamulah kaum yang melampaui batas.

arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
translations.en.pickthall: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
translations.en.yusufali: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka pastilah putusan (azab) Tuhan kita menimpa atas kita; sesungguhnya kita akan merasakan (azab itu).

translations.en.sahih: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
translations.en.pickthall: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
translations.en.yusufali: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kami telah menyesatkan kamu, sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang sesat.

translations.en.sahih: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
translations.en.yusufali: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sesungguhnya mereka pada hari itu bersama-sama dalam azab.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami berbuat terhadap orang-orang yang berbuat jahat.

arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
transliteration: Innahum kaanooo izaa qeela lahum laaa ilaaha illal laahu yastakbiroon

translations.en.sahih: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
translations.en.pickthall: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
translations.en.yusufali: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya mereka dahulu apabila dikatakan kepada mereka: "Laa ilaaha illallah" (Tiada Tuhan yang berhak disembah melainkan Allah) mereka menyombongkan diri,

arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
transliteration: Wa yaqooloona a'innaa lataarikooo aalihatinaa lishaa'irim majnoon

translations.en.sahih: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
translations.en.pickthall: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
translations.en.yusufali: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
translations.id.indonesian: dan mereka berkata: "Apakah sesungguhnya kami harus meninggalkan sembahan-sembahan kami karena seorang penyair gila?"

transliteration: bal jaaa'a bilhaqqi wa saddaqal mursaleen

translations.en.sahih: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
translations.en.yusufali: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).
translations.id.indonesian: Sebenarnya dia (Muhammad) telah datang membawa kebenaran dan membenarkan rasul-rasul (sebelumnya).

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
translations.en.yusufali: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kamu pasti akan merasakan azab yang pedih.

arabic: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Wa maa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.en.sahih: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
translations.en.pickthall: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
translations.en.yusufali: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kamu tidak diberi pembalasan melainkan terhadap kejahatan yang telah kamu kerjakan,

translations.en.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
translations.en.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;
translations.en.yusufali: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-
translations.id.indonesian: tetapi hamba-hamba Allah yang dibersihkan (dari dosa).

translations.en.sahih: Those will have a provision determined -
translations.en.pickthall: For them there is a known provision,
translations.en.yusufali: For them is a Sustenance determined,
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka itu memperoleh rezeki yang tertentu,

translations.en.sahih: Fruits; and they will be honored
translations.en.pickthall: Fruits. And they will be honoured
translations.en.yusufali: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
translations.id.indonesian: yaitu buah-buahan. Dan mereka adalah orang-orang yang dimuliakan,

translations.en.sahih: In gardens of pleasure
translations.en.pickthall: In the Gardens of delight,
translations.en.yusufali: In Gardens of Felicity,
translations.id.indonesian: di dalam surga-surga yang penuh nikmat.

translations.en.sahih: On thrones facing one another.
translations.en.pickthall: On couches facing one another;
translations.en.yusufali: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
translations.id.indonesian: di atas takhta-takhta kebesaran berhadap-hadapan.

translations.en.sahih: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
translations.en.pickthall: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
translations.en.yusufali: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
translations.id.indonesian: Diedarkan kepada mereka gelas yang berisi khamar dari sungai yang mengalir.

translations.en.sahih: White and delicious to the drinkers;
translations.en.pickthall: White, delicious to the drinkers,
translations.en.yusufali: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),
translations.id.indonesian: (Warnanya) putih bersih, sedap rasanya bagi orang-orang yang minum.

arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
transliteration: Laa feehaa ghawlunw wa laa hum 'anhaa yunzafoon

translations.en.sahih: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.
translations.en.yusufali: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
translations.id.indonesian: Tidak ada dalam khamar itu alkohol dan mereka tiada mabuk karenanya.

translations.en.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
translations.en.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,
translations.en.yusufali: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).
translations.id.indonesian: Di sisi mereka ada bidadari-bidadari yang tidak liar pandangannya dan jelita matanya,

translations.en.sahih: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
translations.en.pickthall: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).
translations.en.yusufali: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.
translations.id.indonesian: seakan-akan mereka adalah telur (burung unta) yang tersimpan dengan baik.

translations.en.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
translations.en.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
translations.en.yusufali: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu sebahagian mereka menghadap kepada sebahagian yang lain sambil bercakap-cakap.

arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ
transliteration: Qaala qaaa'ilum minhum innee kaana lee qareen

translations.en.sahih: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
translations.en.pickthall: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
translations.en.yusufali: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),
translations.id.indonesian: Berkatalah salah seorang di antara mereka: "Sesungguhnya aku dahulu (di dunia) mempunyai seorang teman,

translations.en.sahih: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
translations.en.pickthall: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?
translations.en.yusufali: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?
translations.id.indonesian: yang berkata: "Apakah kamu sungguh-sungguh termasuk orang-orang yang membenarkan (hari berbangkit)?

arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
transliteration: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamadeenoon

translations.en.sahih: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
translations.en.pickthall: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
translations.en.yusufali: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah bila kita telah mati dan kita telah menjadi tanah dan tulang belulang, apakah sesungguhnya kita benar-benar (akan dibangkitkan) untuk diberi pembalasan?"

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
translations.en.pickthall: He saith: Will ye look?
translations.en.yusufali: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkata pulalah ia: "Maukah kamu meninjau (temanku itu)?"

transliteration: Fattala'a fara aahu fee sawaaa'il Jaheem

translations.en.sahih: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
translations.en.pickthall: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
translations.en.yusufali: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka ia meninjaunya, lalu dia melihat temannya itu di tengah-tengah neraka menyala-nyala.

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.
translations.en.pickthall: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!
translations.id.indonesian: Ia berkata (pula): "Demi Allah, sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar hampir mencelakakanku,

arabic: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
transliteration: Wa law laa ni'matu Rabbee lakuntu minal muhdareen

translations.en.sahih: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
translations.en.pickthall: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).
translations.en.yusufali: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!
translations.id.indonesian: jikalau tidaklah karena nikmat Tuhanku pastilah aku termasuk orang-orang yang diseret (ke neraka).

translations.en.sahih: Then, are we not to die
translations.en.pickthall: Are we then not to die
translations.en.yusufali: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kita tidak akan mati?,

arabic: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
transliteration: Illa mawtatanal oola wa maa nahnu bimu'azzabeen

translations.en.sahih: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
translations.en.pickthall: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?
translations.en.yusufali: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"
translations.id.indonesian: melainkan hanya kematian kita yang pertama saja (di dunia), dan kita tidak akan disiksa (di akhirat ini)?

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily this is the supreme achievement!
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar kemenangan yang besar.

translations.en.sahih: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
translations.en.pickthall: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
translations.en.yusufali: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.
translations.id.indonesian: Untuk kemenangan serupa ini hendaklah berusaha orang-orang yang bekerja"

arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
transliteration: Azaalika khairun nuzulan am shajaratuz Zaqqom

translations.en.sahih: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
translations.en.pickthall: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?
translations.en.yusufali: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?
translations.id.indonesian: (Makanan surga) itukah hidangan yang lebih baik ataukah pohon zaqqum.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.
translations.en.yusufali: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami menjadikan pohon zaqqum itu sebagai siksaan bagi orang-orang yang zalim.

arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Innahaa shajaratun takhruju feee aslil Jaheem

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
translations.en.yusufali: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya dia adalah sebatang pohon yang ke luar dan dasar neraka yang menyala.

translations.en.sahih: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
translations.en.pickthall: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils
translations.en.yusufali: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:
translations.id.indonesian: mayangnya seperti kepala syaitan-syaitan.

arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
transliteration: Fa innahum la aakiloona minhaa famaali'oona minhal butoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.
translations.en.yusufali: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar memakan sebagian dari buah pohon itu, maka mereka memenuhi perutnya dengan buah zaqqum itu.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
transliteration: Summa inna lahum 'alaihaa lashawbam min hameem

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
translations.en.pickthall: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
translations.en.yusufali: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian sesudah makan buah pohon zaqqum itu pasti mereka mendapat minuman yang bercampur dengan air yang sangat panas.

transliteration: Summa inna marji'ahum la ilal Jaheem

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
translations.en.pickthall: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
translations.en.yusufali: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian sesungguhnya tempat kembali mereka benar-benar ke neraka Jahim.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
translations.en.pickthall: They indeed found their fathers astray,
translations.en.yusufali: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;
translations.id.indonesian: Karena sesungguhnya mereka mendapati bapak-bapak mereka dalam Keadaaan sesat.

translations.en.sahih: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
translations.en.pickthall: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
translations.en.yusufali: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu mereka sangat tergesa-gesa mengikuti jejak orang-orang tua mereka itu.

transliteration: Wa laqad dalla qablahum aksarul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
translations.en.pickthall: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
translations.en.yusufali: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah sesat sebelum mereka (Quraisy) sebagian besar dari orang-orang yang dahulu,

translations.en.sahih: And We had already sent among them warners.
translations.en.pickthall: And verily We sent among them warners.
translations.en.yusufali: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya telah Kami utus pemberi-pemberi peringatan (rasul-rasul) di kalangan mereka.

translations.en.sahih: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
translations.en.pickthall: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,
translations.en.yusufali: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka perhatikanlah bagaimana kesudahan orang-orang yang diberi peringatan itu.

translations.en.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
translations.en.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
translations.en.yusufali: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi hamba-hamba Allah yang bersihkan (dari dosa tidak akan diazab).

transliteration: Wa laqad naadaanaa Noohun falani'mal mujeeboon

translations.en.sahih: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
translations.en.pickthall: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
translations.en.yusufali: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Nuh telah menyeru Kami: maka sesungguhnya sebaik-baik yang memperkenankan (adalah Kami).

transliteration: Wa jajainaahu wa ahlahoo minal karbil 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
translations.en.pickthall: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
translations.en.yusufali: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah menyelamatkannya dan pengikutnya dari bencana yang besar.

translations.en.sahih: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
translations.en.pickthall: And made his seed the survivors,
translations.en.yusufali: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami jadikan anak cucunya orang-orang yang melanjutkan keturunan.

translations.en.sahih: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
translations.en.pickthall: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
translations.en.yusufali: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami abadikan untuk Nuh itu (pujian yang baik) di kalangan orang-orang yang datang kemudian;

translations.en.sahih: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
translations.en.pickthall: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
translations.en.yusufali: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"
translations.id.indonesian: "Kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas Nuh di seluruh alam".

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
translations.en.yusufali: For he was one of our believing Servants.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya dia termasuk di antara hamba-hamba Kami yang beriman.

translations.en.sahih: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We did drown the others.
translations.en.yusufali: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami tenggelamkan orang-orang yang lain.

transliteration: Wa ina min shee'atihee la Ibraaheem

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
translations.en.yusufali: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Ibrahim benar-benar termasuk golongannya (Nuh).

transliteration: Iz jaaa'a Rabbahoo bi qalbin saleem

translations.en.sahih: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
translations.en.pickthall: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.
translations.id.indonesian: (lngatlah) ketika ia datang kepada Tuhannya dengan hati yang suci:

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
transliteration: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maazaa ta'budoon

translations.en.sahih: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
translations.en.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
translations.en.yusufali: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?
translations.id.indonesian: (Ingatlah) ketika ia berkata kepada bapaknya dan kaumnya: "Apakah yang kamu sembah itu?

translations.en.sahih: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
translations.en.pickthall: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?
translations.en.yusufali: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah kamu menghendaki sembahan-sembahan selain Allah dengan jalan berbohong?

translations.en.sahih: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
translations.en.pickthall: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
translations.en.yusufali: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah anggapanmu terhadap Tuhan semesta alam?"

translations.en.sahih: And he cast a look at the stars
translations.en.pickthall: And he glanced a glance at the stars
translations.en.yusufali: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu ia memandang sekali pandang ke bintang-bintang.

translations.en.sahih: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
translations.en.pickthall: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
translations.en.yusufali: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian ia berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku sakit".

translations.en.sahih: So they turned away from him, departing.
translations.en.pickthall: And they turned their backs and went away from him.
translations.en.yusufali: So they turned away from him, and departed.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu mereka berpaling daripadanya dengan membelakang.

arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
transliteration: Faraagha ilaaa aalihatihim faqaala alaa taakuloon

translations.en.sahih: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
translations.en.pickthall: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
translations.en.yusufali: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian ia pergi dengan diam-diam kepada berhala-berhala mereka; lalu ia berkata: "Apakah kamu tidak makan?

translations.en.sahih: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
translations.en.pickthall: What aileth you that ye speak not?
translations.en.yusufali: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"
translations.id.indonesian: Kenapa kamu tidak menjawab?"

translations.en.sahih: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
translations.en.pickthall: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.
translations.en.yusufali: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu dihadapinya berhala-berhala itu sambil memukulnya dengan tangan kanannya (dengan kuat).

translations.en.sahih: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
translations.en.pickthall: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
translations.en.yusufali: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian kaumnya datang kepadanya dengan bergegas.

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
translations.en.pickthall: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?
translations.id.indonesian: Ibrahim berkata: "Apakah kamu menyembah patung-patung yang kamu pahat itu?

translations.en.sahih: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
translations.en.pickthall: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?
translations.en.yusufali: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"
translations.id.indonesian: Padahal Allah-lah yang menciptakan kamu dan apa yang kamu perbuat itu".

arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Qaalub noo lahoo bun yaanan fa alqoohu fil jaheem

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
translations.en.yusufali: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Dirikanlah suatu bangunan untuk (membakar) Ibrahim; lalu lemparkanlah dia ke dalam api yang menyala-nyala itu".

transliteration: Fa araadoo bihee kaidan faja 'alnaahumul asfaleen

translations.en.sahih: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
translations.en.pickthall: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.
translations.en.yusufali: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka hendak melakukan tipu muslihat kepadanya, maka Kami jadikan mereka orang-orang yang hina.

arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
transliteration: Wa qaala innee zaahibun ilaa Rabbee sa yahdeen

translations.en.sahih: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
translations.en.pickthall: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Ibrahim berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku pergi menghadap kepada Tuhanku, dan Dia akan memberi petunjuk kepadaku.

translations.en.sahih: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
translations.en.pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.
translations.en.yusufali: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"
translations.id.indonesian: Ya Tuhanku, anugrahkanlah kepadaku (seorang anak) yang termasuk orang-orang yang saleh.

translations.en.sahih: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
translations.en.pickthall: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.
translations.en.yusufali: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Kami beri dia khabar gembira dengan seorang anak yang amat sabar.

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
transliteration: Falamma balagha ma'a hus sa'ya qaala yaa buniya inneee araa fil manaami anneee azbahuka fanzur maazaa taraa; qaala yaaa abatif 'al maa tu'maru satajidunee in shaaa'allaahu minas saabireen

translations.en.sahih: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
translations.en.pickthall: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.
translations.en.yusufali: Then, when (the son) reached (the age of) (serious) work with him, he said: "O my son! I see in vision that I offer thee in sacrifice: Now see what is thy view!" (The son) said: "O my father! Do as thou art commanded: thou will find me, if Allah so wills one practising Patience and Constancy!"
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tatkala anak itu sampai (pada umur sanggup) berusaha bersama-sama Ibrahim, Ibrahim berkata: "Hai anakku sesungguhnya aku melihat dalam mimpi bahwa aku menyembelihmu. Maka fikirkanlah apa pendapatmu!" Ia menjawab: "Hai bapakku, kerjakanlah apa yang diperintahkan kepadamu; insya Allah kamu akan mendapatiku termasuk orang-orang yang sabar".

translations.en.sahih: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
translations.en.pickthall: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,
translations.en.yusufali: So when they had both submitted their wills (to Allah), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (for sacrifice),
translations.id.indonesian: Tatkala keduanya telah berserah diri dan Ibrahim membaringkan anaknya atas pelipis(nya), (nyatalah kesabaran keduanya).

translations.en.sahih: We called to him, "O Abraham,
translations.en.pickthall: We called unto him: O Abraham!
translations.en.yusufali: We called out to him "O Abraham!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami panggillah dia: "Hai Ibrahim,

arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
transliteration: Qad saddaqtar ru'yaa; innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

translations.en.sahih: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.
translations.en.yusufali: "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya kamu telah membenarkan mimpi itu sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! that verily was a clear test.
translations.en.yusufali: For this was obviously a trial-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar suatu ujian yang nyata.

translations.en.sahih: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
translations.en.pickthall: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.
translations.en.yusufali: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tebus anak itu dengan seekor sembelihan yang besar.

translations.en.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
translations.en.pickthall: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
translations.en.yusufali: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
translations.id.indonesian: Kami abadikan untuk Ibrahim itu (pujian yang baik) di kalangan orang-orang yang datang kemudian,

translations.en.sahih: "Peace upon Abraham."
translations.en.pickthall: Peace be unto Abraham!
translations.en.yusufali: "Peace and salutation to Abraham!"
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu)"Kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas Ibrahim".

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.pickthall: Thus do We reward the good.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
translations.id.indonesian: Demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
translations.en.yusufali: For he was one of our believing Servants.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ia termasuk hamba-hamba Kami yang beriman.

transliteration: Wa bashsharnaahu bi Ishaaqa Nabiyayam minas saaliheen

translations.en.sahih: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.
translations.en.yusufali: And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami beri dia kabar gembira dengan (kelahiran) Ishaq seorang nabi yang termasuk orang-orang yang saleh.

arabic: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
transliteration: Wa baaraknaa 'alaihi wa 'alaaa Ishaaq; wa min zurriyya tihimaa muhsinunw wa zaalimul linafshihee mubeen

translations.en.sahih: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
translations.en.pickthall: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
translations.en.yusufali: We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.
translations.id.indonesian: Kami limpahkan keberkatan atasnya dan atas Ishaq. Dan diantara anak cucunya ada yang berbuat baik dan ada (pula) yang Zalim terhadap dirinya sendiri dengan nyata.

transliteration: Wa laqad mananna alaa Moosaa wa Haaroon

translations.en.sahih: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
translations.en.pickthall: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,
translations.en.yusufali: Again (of old) We bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah melimpahkan nikmat atas Musa dan Harun.

transliteration: Wa najjainaahumaa wa qawmahumaa minal karbil 'azeem

translations.en.sahih: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
translations.en.pickthall: And saved them and their people from the great distress,
translations.en.yusufali: And We delivered them and their people from (their) Great Calamity;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami selamatkan keduanya dan kaumnya dari bencana yang besar.

translations.en.sahih: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
translations.en.pickthall: And helped them so that they became the victors.
translations.en.yusufali: And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tolong mereka, maka jadilah mereka orang-orang yang menang.

translations.en.sahih: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
translations.en.pickthall: And We gave them the clear Scripture
translations.en.yusufali: And We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami berikan kepada keduanya kitab yang sangat jelas.

translations.en.sahih: And We guided them on the straight path.
translations.en.pickthall: And showed them the right path.
translations.en.yusufali: And We guided them to the Straight Way.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tunjuki keduanya ke jalan yang lurus.

translations.en.sahih: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
translations.en.pickthall: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):
translations.en.yusufali: And We left (this blessing) for them among generations (to come) in later times:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami abadikan untuk keduanya (pujian yang baik) dikalangan orang-orang yang datang kemudian;

translations.en.sahih: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
translations.en.pickthall: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!
translations.en.yusufali: "Peace and salutation to Moses and Aaron!"
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu): "Kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas Musa dan Harun".

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.
translations.en.yusufali: For they were two of our believing Servants.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya keduanya termasuk hamba-hamba Kami yang beriman.

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),
translations.en.yusufali: So also was Elias among those sent (by Us).
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya Ilyas benar-benar termasuk salah seorang rasul-rasul.

translations.en.sahih: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.pickthall: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, he said to his people, "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
translations.id.indonesian: (ingatlah) ketika ia berkata kepada kaumnya: "Mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?

transliteration: Atad'oona Ba'lanw wa tazaroona ahsanal khaaliqeen

translations.en.sahih: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
translations.en.pickthall: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,
translations.en.yusufali: "Will ye call upon Baal and forsake the Best of Creators,-
translations.id.indonesian: Patutkah kamu menyembah Ba'l dan kamu tinggalkan sebaik-baik Pencipta,

transliteration: Allaaha Rabbakum wa Rabba aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
translations.en.pickthall: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?
translations.en.yusufali: "Allah, your Lord and Cherisher and the Lord and Cherisher of your fathers of old?"
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) Allah Tuhanmu dan Tuhan bapak-bapakmu yang terdahulu?"

translations.en.sahih: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
translations.en.pickthall: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
translations.en.yusufali: But they rejected him, and they will certainly be called up (for punishment),-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka mendustakannya, karena itu mereka akan diseret (ke neraka),

translations.en.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
translations.en.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
translations.en.yusufali: Except the sincere and devoted Servants of Allah (among them).
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali hamba-hamba Allah yang dibersihkan (dari dosa).

translations.en.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
translations.en.pickthall: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
translations.en.yusufali: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami abadikan untuk Ilyas (pujian yang baik) di kalangan orang-orang yang datang kemudian.

translations.en.sahih: "Peace upon Elias."
translations.en.pickthall: Peace be unto Elias!
translations.en.yusufali: "Peace and salutation to such as Elias!"
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu): "Kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas Ilyas?"

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.
translations.en.yusufali: For he was one of our believing Servants.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya dia termasuk hamba-hamba Kami yang beriman.

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).
translations.en.yusufali: So also was Lut among those sent (by Us).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Luth benar-benar salah seorang rasul.

translations.en.sahih: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
translations.en.pickthall: When We saved him and his household, every one,
translations.en.yusufali: Behold, We delivered him and his adherents, all
translations.id.indonesian: (Ingatlah) ketika Kami selamatkan dia dan keluarganya (pengikut-pengikutnya) semua,

translations.en.sahih: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
translations.en.pickthall: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;
translations.en.yusufali: Except an old woman who was among those who lagged behind:
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali seorang perempuan tua (isterinya yang berada) bersama-sama orang yang tinggal.

translations.en.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We destroyed the others.
translations.en.yusufali: Then We destroyed the rest.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami binasakan orang-orang yang lain.

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, ye pass by their (sites), by day-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya kamu (hai penduduk Mekah) benar-benar akan melalui (bekas-bekas) mereka di waktu pagi,

translations.en.sahih: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
translations.en.pickthall: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?
translations.en.yusufali: And by night: will ye not understand?
translations.id.indonesian: dan di waktu malam. Maka apakah kamu tidak memikirkan?

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
translations.en.yusufali: So also was Jonah among those sent (by Us).
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Yunus benar-benar salah seorang rasul,

transliteration: Iz abaqa ilal fulkil mash hoon

translations.en.sahih: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
translations.en.pickthall: When he fled unto the laden ship,
translations.en.yusufali: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,
translations.id.indonesian: (ingatlah) ketika ia lari, ke kapal yang penuh muatan,

translations.en.sahih: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
translations.en.pickthall: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;
translations.en.yusufali: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian ia ikut berundi lalu dia termasuk orang-orang yang kalah dalam undian.

translations.en.sahih: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
translations.en.pickthall: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;
translations.en.yusufali: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka ia ditelan oleh ikan besar dalam keadaan tercela.

transliteration: Falaw laaa annahoo kaana minal musabbiheen

translations.en.sahih: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,
translations.en.pickthall: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)
translations.en.yusufali: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kalau sekiranya dia tidak termasuk orang-orang yang banyak mengingat Allah,

arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
transliteration: Lalabisa fee batniheee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

translations.en.sahih: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
translations.en.pickthall: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;
translations.en.yusufali: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.
translations.id.indonesian: niscaya ia akan tetap tinggal di perut ikan itu sampai hari berbangkit.

translations.en.sahih: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
translations.en.pickthall: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;
translations.en.yusufali: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian Kami lemparkan dia ke daerah yang tandus, sedang ia dalam keadaan sakit.

translations.en.sahih: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
translations.en.pickthall: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;
translations.en.yusufali: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami tumbuhkan untuk dia sebatang pohon dari jenis labu.

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
transliteration: Wa arsalnaahu ilaa mi'ati alfin aw yazeedoon

translations.en.sahih: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
translations.en.pickthall: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
translations.en.yusufali: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami utus dia kepada seratus ribu orang atau lebih.

transliteration: Fa aamanoo famatta' naahum ilaa heen

translations.en.sahih: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
translations.en.pickthall: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.
translations.en.yusufali: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu mereka beriman, karena itu Kami anugerahkan kenikmatan hidup kepada mereka hingga waktu yang tertentu.

transliteration: Fastaftihim ali Rabbikal banaatu wa lahumul banoon

translations.en.sahih: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
translations.en.pickthall: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?
translations.en.yusufali: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-
translations.id.indonesian: Tanyakanlah (ya Muhammad) kepada mereka (orang-orang kafir Mekah): "Apakah untuk Tuhanmu anak-anak perempuan dan untuk mereka anak laki-laki,

arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
transliteration: Am khalaqnal malaaa'i kata inaasanw wa hm shaahidoon

translations.en.sahih: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
translations.en.pickthall: Or created We the angels females while they were present?
translations.en.yusufali: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?
translations.id.indonesian: atau apakah Kami menciptakan malaikat-malaikat berupa perempuan dan mereka menyaksikan(nya)?

transliteration: Alaaa innahum min ifkihim la yaqooloon

translations.en.sahih: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:
translations.en.yusufali: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,
translations.id.indonesian: Ketahuilah bahwa sesungguhnya mereka dengan kebohongannya benar-benar mengatakan:

translations.en.sahih: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
translations.en.pickthall: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.
translations.en.yusufali: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!
translations.id.indonesian: "Allah beranak". Dan sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar orang yang berdusta.

translations.en.sahih: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
translations.en.pickthall: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.
translations.en.yusufali: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah Tuhan memilih (mengutamakan) anak-anak perempuan daripada anak laki-laki?

translations.en.sahih: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
translations.en.pickthall: What aileth you? How judge ye?
translations.en.yusufali: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah yang terjadi padamu? Bagaimana (caranya) kamu menetapkan?

translations.en.sahih: Then will you not be reminded?
translations.en.pickthall: Will ye not then reflect?
translations.en.yusufali: Will ye not then receive admonition?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah kamu tidak memikirkan?

translations.en.sahih: Or do you have a clear authority?
translations.en.pickthall: Or have ye a clear warrant?
translations.en.yusufali: Or have ye an authority manifest?
translations.id.indonesian: Atau apakah kamu mempunyai bukti yang nyata?

transliteration: Faatoo bi Kitaabikum in kuntum saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
translations.en.pickthall: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
translations.en.yusufali: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bawalah kitabmu jika kamu memang orang-orang yang benar.

arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
transliteration: Wa ja'aloo bainahoo wa bainal jinnati nasabaa; wa laqad 'alimatil jinnatu innahum lamuhdaroon

translations.en.sahih: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
translations.en.pickthall: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
translations.en.yusufali: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka adakan (hubungan) nasab antara Allah dan antara jin. Dan sesungguhnya jin mengetahui bahwa mereka benar-benar akan diseret (ke neraka),

translations.en.sahih: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
translations.en.pickthall: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),
translations.en.yusufali: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!
translations.id.indonesian: Maha Suci Allah dari apa yang mereka sifatkan,

translations.en.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
translations.en.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
translations.en.yusufali: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.
translations.id.indonesian: Kecuali hamba-hamba Allah yang dibersihkan dari (dosa).

translations.en.sahih: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,
translations.en.yusufali: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka sesungguhnya kamu dan apa-apa yang kamu sembah itu,

translations.en.sahih: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
translations.en.pickthall: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.
translations.en.yusufali: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,
translations.id.indonesian: Sekali-kali tidak dapat menyesatkan (seseorang) terhadap Allah,

translations.en.sahih: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
translations.en.pickthall: Save him who is to burn in hell.
translations.en.yusufali: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali orang-orang yang akan masuk neraka yang menyala.

arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
transliteration: Wa maa minnasa illaa lahoo maqaamum ma'loom

translations.en.sahih: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
translations.en.pickthall: There is not one of us but hath his known position.
translations.en.yusufali: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
translations.id.indonesian: Tiada seorangpun di antara kami (malaikat) melainkan mempunyai kedudukan yang tertentu,

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,
translations.en.yusufali: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);
translations.id.indonesian: dan sesungguhnya kami benar-benar bershaf-shaf (dalam menunaikan perintah Allah).

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
translations.en.yusufali: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya kami benar-benar bertasbih (kepada Allah).

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
translations.en.pickthall: And indeed they used to say:
translations.en.yusufali: And there were those who said,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar akan berkata:

arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
translations.en.pickthall: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
translations.en.yusufali: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,
translations.id.indonesian: "Kalau sekiranya di sksi kami ada sebuah kitab dari (kitab-kitab yang diturunkan) kepada orang-orang dahulu,

translations.en.sahih: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
translations.en.pickthall: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.
translations.en.yusufali: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"
translations.id.indonesian: benar-benar kami akan jadi hamba Allah yang dibersihkan (dari dosa)".

translations.en.sahih: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
translations.en.pickthall: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.
translations.en.yusufali: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi mereka mengingkarinya (Al Quran); maka kelak mereka akan mengetahui (akibat keingkarannya itu).

transliteration: Wa laqad sabaqat Kalimatunaa li'ibaadinal mursa leen

translations.en.sahih: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
translations.en.pickthall: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
translations.en.yusufali: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya telah tetap janji Kami kepada hamba-hamba Kami yang menjadi rasul,

translations.en.sahih: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
translations.en.pickthall: That they verily would be helped,
translations.en.yusufali: That they would certainly be assisted,
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) sesungguhnya mereka itulah yang pasti mendapat pertolongan.

translations.en.sahih: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
translations.en.pickthall: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
translations.en.yusufali: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya tentara Kami itulah yang pasti menang,

translations.en.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
translations.en.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,
translations.en.yusufali: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berpalinglah kamu (Muhammad) dari mereka sampai suatu ketika.

translations.en.sahih: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
translations.en.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
translations.en.yusufali: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan lihatlah mereka, maka kelak mereka akan melihat (azab itu).

translations.en.sahih: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
translations.en.pickthall: Would they hasten on Our doom?
translations.en.yusufali: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah mereka meminta supaya siksa Kami disegerakan?

arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
transliteration: Fa izaa nazala bisaahatihim fasaaa'a sabaahul munzareen

translations.en.sahih: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
translations.en.pickthall: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.
translations.en.yusufali: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila siksaan itu turun dihalaman mereka, maka amat buruklah pagi hari yang dialami oleh orang-orang yang diperingatkan itu.

translations.en.sahih: And leave them for a time.
translations.en.pickthall: Withdraw from them awhile
translations.en.yusufali: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berpalinglah kamu dari mereka hingga suatu ketika.

translations.en.sahih: And see, for they are going to see.
translations.en.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
translations.en.yusufali: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan lihatlah, maka kelak mereka juga akan melihat.

arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
translations.en.pickthall: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
translations.en.yusufali: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!
translations.id.indonesian: Maha Suci Tuhanmu Yang mempunyai keperkasaan dari apa yang mereka katakan.

translations.en.sahih: And peace upon the messengers.
translations.en.pickthall: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
translations.en.yusufali: And Peace on the messengers!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas para rasul.

translations.en.sahih: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
translations.en.yusufali: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan seru sekalian alam.
